datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a regular (typically monthly) schedule and spatially attributed to sub-national administrative units in Madagascar. The resulting GeoJSON/KML files encode IPC scenario values, classification scales, and collection dates for three reference periods in 2018, enabling temporal tracking of food insecurity severity across the country.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification spatial data on a regular schedule, assigning acute food insecurity phase scores to sub-national geographic units in Madagascar. The data represents current situation scenarios for February, June, and December 2018.
